meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数字、标题或品牌标志做成几秒钟的动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用短短几秒的动效把数字、标题或品牌讲清楚
copy.tagline_en: Turn a stat, headline, or logo into a few seconds of animated motion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a few-second animated clip to make a number or brand land.

howto.what: 做的是短的、设计驱动的动效图形,通常 10 秒内,无旁白、无真人主体,产出 MP4 或透明叠加层。流程是先定素材策略、再设计镜头,复用已有组件合成,通过校验与快照后,问你要预览还是渲染。
howto.when: 当你要一段短的、无旁白的动效图形(动态文字、数字滚动、图表等)时接管;更长、带旁白或多场景的会转给 /general-video,情况不明则先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 做一段 10 秒的动效视频,把这句话做成动态文字
say.note: 会先出镜头方案再合成渲染

howto.what_en: Short, design-led motion graphics, under 10s, no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. It sets the asset strategy, designs the shot, reuses catalog blocks, and asks preview-or-render before rendering.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you want a short, unnarrated motion graphic such as kinetic typography, a stat count-up or a chart. Longer, narrated or multi-scene goes to /general-video; unclear goes to /hyperframes.
